text: so pull up one of these functions in full and show me what it looks like and what it should look like when following the zig 0.16 api
resolution: Performed a single-agent read-only comparison using framework/gpu/paint_program.zig and the bundled Zig 0.16 std source. Selected replayAll as a real caller of host_io.Timer. Verified that the shim fabricates the deleted 0.15 Timer error-returning shape even though std.Io.Clock.Timestamp.now is non-erroring, and prepared the exact explicit-std.Io rewrite using an injected std.Io, Clock.Timestamp.now(io, .awake), and untilNow(io). No files changed.
